title: The Fat Myth

scenes.text: What if 3 g of saturated fat daily isn’t a disaster?
Most people believe any saturated fat will raise cholesterol and cause heart disease.
scenes.label: All saturated fat is bad

scenes.text: Research shows that moderate saturated fat (≈3 g) in the context of a balanced diet does not significantly raise LDL cholesterol for most people.
scenes.label: Moderate sat fat ok

scenes.text: Focus on overall diet quality, not just one nutrient.
scenes.label: Diet Quality Over Fat
scenes.sub: Balance matters more than a single gram count

scenes.text: Follow for daily tips to feel your best.

description: Busting the idea that every gram of saturated fat is dangerous. Learn the real impact of a modest amount and how to keep your meals balanced. Follow for more practical health hacks.
